title: SupervisorIntervention
description: One pre-emptive control action invoked by the supervisor. Append-only entry in logs/meta/<project>/interventions.jsonl. Each invocation routes through the existing TaskRunnerService methods; the runner remains the single state-machine authority. Mirrors backend/Services/Supervisor/SupervisorContract.cs::SupervisorIntervention.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the intervention was invoked.

kind.description: Which emergency primitive was invoked. CancelRun and ForceFail require a jobId; PausePickup may carry a TTL; Resume lifts a pause.

source.description: Who decided to invoke. User is a manual click in the supervisor panel; AutoIntervention is the gated automatic policy; HardCheck and SoftReasoning record themselves only when they (rarely) escalate.

reason.description: Mandatory typed reason, propagated to the orchestrator chat log so the activity feed shows why an intervention fired.

jobId.description: Required for CancelRun and ForceFail; null for PausePickup and Resume (they target the project, not a single run).

pauseTtl.description: ISO 8601 duration (or .NET TimeSpan string) for PausePickup. After the TTL elapses the runner auto-resumes. Null when not applicable.
